content: Validation Semantics of global ConcreteClassTailoring . multiplicityRestriction with validationRoot ==true If the ConcreteClassTailoring is directly aggregated by DataFormatTailor- ing . classTailoring and ConcreteClassTailoring . validationRoot ==true then the MultiplicityRestrictionWithSeverity is evaluated for all instances of the concrete meta class in the context of the complete model (not only the reach- able elements). This evaluation can happen before the set of reachable elements is calculated.
